name: rails
one_liner: A toolkit that lets a small team build a full website, with database and forms, fast, without reinventing the basics.
buyer: A freelance web developer who builds client sites and wants to ship faster so they can take on more paying clients.
business_use_cases: A freelancer builds and resells a 'launch your SaaS in a week' Rails starter template to indie founders.
An agency builds client MVPs on Rails and charges a fixed project fee because the framework lets them deliver in roughly half the time of a from-scratch build.
A bootcamp sells 'become a Rails freelancer' courses to career switchers, since demand for fast-shipping Rails devs stays steady.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a polished Rails SaaS-starter kit (auth, billing, admin panel) to indie hackers
Freelance or agency web development services built on Rails

steal_this: Build and sell a Rails SaaS starter kit with auth, Stripe billing, and an admin panel already wired up.
